responsibility: This is the main C++ implementation file for the H8/300 backend, containing the target hooks, operand/address classification, instruction-length and cost computation, asm operand printing, calling convention logic, function attributes and pragmas, prologue/epilogue support, trampoline generation, reorg, and miscellaneous code-generation helpers referenced from the .md files. It owns the non-declarative backend behavior for H8/H8S/H8SX, including helpers like output_plussi, output_logical_op, shift emission/length logic, data-section attribute handling, sibcall eligibility, and initialization of the targetm hook table.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling h8300.h, h8300.md, and h8300.opt files, this is the executable backend implementation: it defines the H8 target hook functions and helper routines that carry out behaviors the machine description and macros refer to, such as operand/address classification, asm printing, calling conventions, prologue/epilogue handling, reorg, and target initialization.
